# LTX-2

> > Open-source AI video generation model producing broadcast-quality 4K video at 48fps with real-time preview capabilities.

LTX-2 is an advanced AI video generation platform that reimagines content creation with support for high-resolution output, audio-video synchronization, and integration with professional tools like ComfyUI, After Effects, and Nuke. The model is optimized for GPU performance and available through platforms like GitHub, Fal, and Replicate.

## Key Topics

- LTX-2
- AI video generation
- 4K video output
- 48fps rendering
- Open-source model
- Broadcast-quality video
- Audio-video synchronization
- ComfyUI integration
- GPU optimization
- Real-time preview
- LoRA support
- Content creation
- Video production workflows
- Fal and Replicate platforms

## Core Platform

- [LTX-2 - AI Video Generation Reimagined(4K, Online)](https://ltx-2.net): Main homepage for LTX-2 open-source AI video generation model with 4K output
- [LTX-2 - 重新定义AI视频生成(4K, 在线)](https://ltx-2.net/zh): Chinese homepage for LTX-2 open-source AI video generation at 4K@48fps
